_meta.description: Seed split for v23 experiments. Development seeds are used for detector training, hyperparameter tuning, and all iterative/exploratory work. Confirmatory seeds are held out and used ONLY for Phase 7+ confirmatory hypothesis tests (v23 §7.2, §10). No detector, no hparam, no defense is ever tuned on confirmatory seeds.
_meta.v23_rule: 3.5 — Do not train the detector on the same seeds or physical clients used for confirmatory evaluation
